# DNK OS Client Portal & Sovereign Shopify Architecture
> Authentic, Agent-Ready living documentation and commercial workspace for bespoke Shopify engineering.

## Overview
This portal provides the complete technical audit, commercial proposal, and interactive prototypes for the client project.

## Documents
- [Main Workspace](index.html): Executive project brief, key deliverables, and scope overview.
- [Technical Audit](audit.html): Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) audit, Liquid theme diagnostics, and third-party app weight breakdown.
- [Commercial Proposal](proposal.html): Implementation phases, deliverables, investment tiers, and warranty terms.
- [Interactive Demo](demo.html): Live prototypes of custom Shopify CRO Theme Blocks, ROI calculator, and Before/After slider.

## Design System & Stack
- Architecture: Shopify Online Store 2.0 (Theme Blocks v2, zero external app bloat)
- Design Tokens: W3C DTCG-2025.10 Specification
- Edge Runtime: Cloudflare Pages with Edge Password Gate
- In-Context Feedback: dnk-sensor.js with Area Marquee & Pinning
